name: How long does a lower countertop installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a lower countertop installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for a lower countertop depends on several factors, including the countertop material, the size of the area, and whether existing cabinetry needs modification. After templating, fabrication can take 1-3 weeks. The actual installation usually takes 1-2 days. More complex projects involving custom cuts or extensive cabinet adjustments might extend this timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 1-2 days after 1-3 weeks of fabrication, depending on material and project complexity.
